onChange.script:
#	system.perspective.print("rowdroppedData change droppedId %s draggedId%s"%(currentValue.value["droppedId"].value, currentValue.value["draggedId"].value))

	if not self.custom.userAction.canCreate: return
	
	droppedRow = int(currentValue.value["droppedId"].value)
	draggedRow = int(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value)
	
	if droppedRow == -1 and draggedRow == -1: return
	
	routeSteps = self.custom.routeStepEvents.data
#	system.perspective.print("Inserting row %s to row %s"%(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value, currentValue.value["droppedId"].value))
#	system.perspective.print("Removing row %s"%(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value))

	if routeSteps[draggedRow]['lotEventId']:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', 'You cannot move a step that has already been completed.')
		self.refreshBinding("custom.routeStepEvents.data")
		return

	for row in range(droppedRow, len(routeSteps)-1):
		if routeSteps[row]['lotEventId']:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', 'You cannot move a step prior to an already completed step')
			self.refreshBinding("custom.routeStepEvents.data")
			return
	
	routeSteps.insert(int(currentValue.value["droppedId"].value), routeSteps.pop(int(currentValue.value["draggedId"].value)))
	self.custom.tableRowDroppedData = {'draggedId': -1, 'droppedId': -1}

	success, msg = system.kanoa.lot.reorderRouteStepEvents(routeSteps, self.custom.security.userId)
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', 'Step Events were not reordered %s'%(msg))
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', "Route Step Events have been reordered")

	self.refreshBinding("custom.routeStepEvents.data")
	
	return
